experiment: Experiment 69.3-G2 - Two selected rows added to fold 2 training

data.sample_ids: 1-based data-row IDs in processed_standard_data.csv; model indices are ID minus one

optimization.best_checkpoint: strict ACC improvement with historical val=test protocol

protocol_limits: This is an intentional train/test overlap diagnostic, not an unbiased generalization experiment.
Only fold 2 adds its listed test rows to its training indices; those rows remain in the fold 2 test set. The other nine folds are unchanged.

The exact E61 epoch-10 warmup parameters, optimizer states, and RNG states are reused; added training indices and relation pairs are constructed after warmup with the fold-local NumPy generator and do not consume the main training RNG.
E62-E2 is the only model configuration; no OOF, reliability multiplier, new loss, new module, or hyperparameter search is used.
Historical val=test checkpoint selection, pre-CV preprocessing, and the transductive 871-node graph are retained.
